intro: Round 4 starts at 512 pixels and follows real meshes down to 16. Better candidate search reduces late triangles; exact repeats share one runtime level.
results_intro: Preventing new topology locks helps coarse reductions. Avoiding duplicate hybrid inputs and using the full existing proposal budget improves the complete chain score.

findings.label: FINAL RETAINED RATIO
findings.title: The last levels use fewer triangles.
findings.text: Category-balanced final retained triangles fall from 3.14% to 1.61%. Last-three-level retained ratio falls 50.9%. Gates and SCORE are unchanged.

findings.label: RUNTIME / AUDIT SLOTS
findings.title: Exact repeats share one mesh.
findings.text: The C/C++ API and glTF export expose compact runtime levels. Every scheduled source and transition audit stays in the manifest and in the score.

findings.label: TREE / CAP 8 vs 2
findings.title: A loose distance budget can lose filled area.
findings.text: The 2-triangle tail passes the denser 706-camera recheck but loses much of the thin trunk’s coverage. Its smaller quad cost includes that coverage loss. Shading is outside this coverage-only run.
